approvalGates.prompt: Review research goal, evidence schema, candidate-generation strategy, budget, and stop criteria before execution.
Review safety, EHS, wet-lab, or experimental actions before execution or recommendation.
Accept parsed evidence ledgers before they replace proxy rankings or support research-grade claims.
Verify claimPolicy.researchGradeRequires and required evidenceSchema entries before any discovery claim.
